content.text:
Data Center Sites Powered by Gas Isn’t the Same As Ready to Build: Enverus forecasts 25.5 GW of BTM demand from new U.S. facilities through 2030, including 22.5 GW of data-center demand (88%); it states gas accounts for 29.6 GW of generation capacity needed. It also describes permitting, pipeline-route, water, community, and project-bankability constraints. (time=2026-09-17; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).
Build More, Wait Less | Modular Gas Wins the BTM Buildout: Enverus forecast that modular gas technologies and fuel cells could serve a large share of future BTM builds, citing shorter deployment timelines than large CCGTs; it also described a natural-gas SOFC as potentially comparable in LCOE to a large-frame CCGT for a 1 GW data center. (time=2026-08-18; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).
Bergen Engines Signs Approx. 750MW U.S. Power Agreement with Crusoe for AI Data Centers: Bergen describes the 750 MW total as approximately a 438 MW contract plus a 310 MW letter of intent, with deliveries phased through 2027. The full headline amount therefore was not all identified as contracted capacity. (time=2026-06-03; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).
